description: Pinned PicoRV32 Wishbone with custom IRQ enabled; generated runtime exposes the real 32-bit IRQ input and EOI output. Uses Pico custom0 IRQ ABI, not RISC-V privileged interrupts.

resets.release: picorv32.v samples resetn in posedge clk sequential blocks; the Wishbone wrapper assigns clk=wb_clk_i and resetn=~wb_rst_i.

capabilities.evidence: picorv32.v top declarations have 32-bit address/data and four byte lanes. max_outstanding=1 is the planned environment limit. No physical error response exists. The physical Wishbone top has no err or stall. The plugin requires err, so a later local transactor needs an explicit no-error/no-stall variant. picorv32.v assigns wbm_adr_o <= mem_addr (byte address) and wbm_sel_o <= mem_wstrb, including zero select on reads; later transactor tests must verify read select behavior.

semantics: Pinned picorv32.v and firmware/custom_ops.S: ENABLE_IRQ=1 exposes a 32-bit custom IRQ vector; getq/setq/maskirq/retirq use custom0 opcode. PROGADDR_IRQ defaults to 0x10; ENABLE_IRQ_QREGS=1 and LATCHED_IRQ=0xffffffff are retained defaults. IRQ bits 0-2 also have internal sources; this acceptance binds external timer IRQ to bit 3.
The source parameters retain ENABLE_PCPI=0. Wishbone addressing/select behavior is identical to the separate picorv32_wb profile.
verified: Focused generated Wishbone acceptance executes the pinned Pico RTL and ziptimer RTL in persistent independent processes: CPU arms the timer via MMIO, native timer IRQ is bound to irq[3], Pico custom handler stores q1=8 and its completion marker in RAM, real eoi returns from 8 to zero, trap remains zero and main RAM transactions resume.
The focused test saves a formal evidence bundle and replays it with new RTL processes; semantic evidence and RAM results match. The separate IRQ-disabled picorv32_wb acceptance suite still passes.
unknown: No standard RISC-V machine-external CSR/trap ABI is implemented or claimed.
Only IRQ3 from the pinned ziptimer and the focused custom handler are covered; nested interrupts, all other IRQ bits and ABI context preservation are unassessed.
